messages:
Connor H: PR #1589 landed some new guidance for embedding batching + quantized models but I noticed the Rust SDK snippet still shows the old batching helper `auto_batch()` which we removed. Also the quant profile link points at `/optimize/qprofiles/legacy` which redirects oddly.

Leila M: Thanks, Connor. I saw the failing snippet test. Quick question: do we prefer to show the new `batcher::with_max_tokens(1024)` API in the quickstart or keep a simple `batch_size: 32` config example?

Yusuf A: For embeddings we should show config + API. My recommendation: simple YAML `batch_size: 32` in quickstart for clarity, and a short Rust example using `with_max_tokens(1024)` in the advanced section. That way users on Dedicated know how to control token-based batching.

Connor H: Sounds good. I'll update the quickstart to explicit `batch_size: 32` and add the Rust advanced snippet in `optimize/advanced.md`. Also will swap the quant link to the stable alias `https://docs.redwood.ai/qprofiles/latest`.

Marta R: One more: customer success reported confusion about tokenizers when switching to q4_0; add a short note that byte-level BPE may change token counts and therefore batching behavior. Maybe include a tiny diagnostic to compare token counts before/after quantization.

Leila M: Good call. We can add this diagnostic (pseudo):
```
# compare token counts (pseudo)
echo \"long prefix\" | ./tokenizer --model rwd-opt-13b | wc -w
echo \"long prefix\" | ./tokenizer --model rwd-opt-13b-q4_0 | wc -w
```
Add note: "If token count differs, reduce batch_size or prefer max_tokens-based batching."

docs-bot: PR #1589 check run started (docs-ci). 3 checks queued.

Yusuf A: Also found a broken internal redirect in `docs/redirects.yaml` referencing `/optimize/qprofiles/legacy`. I can file INFRA-492 and include a suggested redirect to `/qprofiles/latest`.

Connor H: Pushed patch: replaced `auto_batch()` Rust call with `batcher.with_max_tokens(1024)` and added the `batch_size: 32` quickstart line. Swapped quant link to stable alias. Updated migration note about tokenization variance. PR description updated with DOCS-702.

docs-bot: PR #1589 check run succeeded (docs-ci). 4 checks passed.

Leila M: Reviewed and left minor copy suggestions. LGTM after that.

Marta R: I'll draft the short customer-facing FAQ blurb for CS about token-count variance and recommended tuning steps.

Connor H: Merged. Site redeploy queued.

Leila M: Verified on staging: quickstart shows `batch_size: 32`, advanced page includes Rust `with_max_tokens` example, quant link resolves. Closing DOCS-702. :white_check_mark:
